compact_noncompact_separation.compact_reason: Meyer makes every rank-at-least-five indefinite rational lattice isotropic; a finite-volume complete K3 root chamber therefore has a nef isotropic cusp

correct_finite_volume_iff.correct_statement: finite volume iff some/every exact-Picard full-nef K3 carrier has finite Aut iff Eff is rational polyhedral iff Cox is finitely generated

counterexample.finite_volume_reason: the accepted Nikulin--Vinberg exhaustion says every finite-volume rank-11 member is one of its four rows; this lattice is not one
counterexample.logical_use: counterexample to raw carrier-nonemptiness iff finite volume; not a counterexample to the decorated finite-Aut carrier iff

primitive_k3_embedding.witness: one U summand; E7 on first-E8 simple-root nodes [0,1,2,3,4,5,7]; an A2 on second-E8 nodes [0,1]

correct_finite_volume_iff.false_shorthand: finite volume iff the unqualified exact-Picard K3 carrier locus is nonempty

acceptable_forms: an independent geometric classification via surface models, genus-one fibrations, curve configurations, or Cox algebras that derives the finite list
a broader raw-P class on which AG effectivity/moduli removes or constructs cases not fixed by the input Coxeter classification
a genuinely new facet/dimension restriction or positive terminal realization obtained only after the AG stage
not_sufficient: finite Aut iff finite reflection index
literal Vinberg verification of the already listed positives
Roulleau geometric models indexed by the inherited 118-lattice list
missing_l4_gate.required: an AG-native classification/boundedness theorem for the marked K3 carrier loci that does not invoke the Nikulin--Vinberg 2-reflective lattice exhaustion, followed by a polytope conclusion not already contained in that exhaustion

logical_witness.ahl: Theorem 2.12 is explicitly obtained by combining Theorem 2.11 with the prior classification of O(N)/W(N)-finite hyperbolic lattices
logical_witness.roulleau: the atlas starts from the Nikulin--Vinberg Picard-lattice classification and then supplies geometric constructions

strict_score.AG: FAIL_INDEPENDENT_EXHAUSTION: period/Torelli, finite-Aut and Cox-ring equivalences are AG, but the 19/0 list is imported from the Nikulin--Vinberg O(N)/W_2(N)-finite lattice list
strict_score.C: PASS: non-singleton arithmetic lattice/chamber class, though primitive K3-lattice embeddability is built into membership
strict_score.Car: PASS for the declared full-nef K3 carrier species: primitive embedding plus periods realizes every ambient member; the nineteen finite-volume rows have one oriented embedding orbit
strict_score.Pushback: FAIL_NEW_THEOREM: the finite list and no-H19 conclusion restate the same reflective-lattice classification; the literal Vinberg replays verify positives but cannot exhaust rank 20
strict_score.Return: PASS for integrally marked data: K3 Weyl transitivity returns the same complete all-minus-two chamber with no hidden roots
